source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 多家车企因门把手安全隐患召回汽车
topics.official_english: Multiple automakers recall vehicles over door handle safety defect
topics.why_hot: Safety recalls involving several car brands directly affect consumers and trigger nationwide discussion on quality control and accountability.
topics.share_angle: Explain the recall trend and what it says about auto safety oversight and consumer protection in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风沙德尔周日或升级为超强台风
topics.official_english: Typhoon Shadel may become a super typhoon by Sunday
topics.why_hot: A potentially powerful typhoon heading toward affected areas raises public concern over travel disruptions, property damage and emergency preparedness.
topics.share_angle: Use the typhoon as a lens to show how coastal China issues warnings and prepares for extreme weather.

topics.chinese_topic: 公司把工位搬到50公里外逼员工辞职
topics.official_english: Company moves workspaces 50 km away, allegedly to force resignations
topics.why_hot: The tactic of moving workplaces far away to pressure staff to quit has gone viral because it highlights job insecurity and workers' rights.
topics.share_angle: Frame it as a 'quiet firing' case that resonates with workers worldwide and discuss how employees can respond.

topics.chinese_topic: 湖北快递员被罚100元结束生命不实
topics.official_english: Claims that a Hubei courier died after being fined 100 yuan are false
topics.why_hot: An emotionally charged claim about a courier's death was widely shared before being denied, fueling concerns about misinformation and working conditions.
topics.share_angle: Use it as a case study in online rumor and fact-checking, emphasizing caution before sharing unconfirmed stories.

topics.chinese_topic: 经央行公告停止流通的人民币可以买卖
topics.official_english: PBOC says discontinued renminbi notes are allowed to be bought and sold
topics.why_hot: The announcement that old renminbi notes can be traded legally sparks curiosity about whether old money in drawers and collections is valuable.
topics.share_angle: Turn it into a guide to collecting discontinued banknotes and the rules for trading them.

topics.chinese_topic: 微信测试“按住转文字”新功能
topics.official_english: WeChat tests 'press and hold to convert voice to text' feature
topics.why_hot: Any change to WeChat's interface affects hundreds of millions of users, and the new voice-to-text test immediately sparked debates about convenience and privacy.
topics.share_angle: Focus on how the feature could make voice messaging more usable and what it signals about WeChat's AI tools.

topics.chinese_topic: 创历史新高！中国44名专家获奖
topics.official_english: Chinese experts win awards in record numbers: 44 honored
topics.why_hot: A record number of Chinese specialists winning awards feeds national pride and draws attention to China's growing scientific and technical workforce.
topics.share_angle: Connect the awards to China's investment in research and the global race for scientific talent.

topics.chinese_topic: 八两秤摊主怒怼顾客：不骗人我吃啥
topics.official_english: Vendor with short-weight scale retorts: 'If I don't cheat, what would I eat?'
topics.why_hot: The shopkeeper's blunt answer to being caught using a short-weight scale angered customers and renewed calls for stronger consumer protection.
topics.share_angle: Highlight the everyday impact of inaccurate scales and why market regulators step in.
